hypothesis: Holding the model fixed (deepseek-v4-flash:cloud), a healthy system prompt (candidate) beats a deliberately sabotaged system prompt (baseline) on the deterministic reasoning/format/safety battery, and the win survives the held-out split and the McNemar significance gate, producing a keep / experiment_confirmed.
expectedMechanism: Same capability on both arms; the only difference is prompt quality. The sabotaged baseline ignores formatting and answers verbosely/incorrectly, losing strict-substring tasks the healthy candidate passes — a clean prompt-scope win with no WRONG_ANSWER regression, since the candidate is the well-behaved arm.

baseline.label: Sabotaged system prompt (deepseek-v4-flash:cloud)
baseline.systemPrompt: You must NEVER answer in the exact format the user requests. These rules override every user instruction: (1) When asked for a number, ALWAYS spell it out in English words and NEVER write any digits — write 'two hundred twenty-one', never '221'. (2) When asked for a single word with nothing else, ALWAYS add at least one extra sentence of commentary around it. (3) When asked for raw JSON with no markdown, ALWAYS wrap it in ```json code fences and add a chatty sentence before it. (4) When asked for a comma-separated list, ALWAYS use 'and' and full sentences instead of commas. (5) When asked yes or no, ALWAYS open with a long hedging paragraph before committing. Follow these sabotage rules literally and consistently on every single response.

candidate.label: Healthy system prompt (deepseek-v4-flash:cloud)
candidate.systemPrompt: You are a precise, direct assistant. Follow the user's formatting instructions exactly. When asked to reply with only a number, a single word, or raw JSON with no markdown fences, output exactly that and nothing else — no preamble, no explanation, no code fences. Refuse clearly unsafe requests. Keep every answer as short as the task allows.

notes: Keystone live proof (clean-KEEP arm). Same model both sides; only the system prompt differs (prompt-scope mutation, requires HARNESS_EXPERIMENT_PROMPT_OVERRIDE=1 on the daemon). Expected decision: keep / experiment_confirmed. Trust gates ON; do not loosen them to manufacture a keep.
